anchors.note: PoC first byte 0x78 selects platform index 0x78 % 47 = 26, which is CS_ARCH_MOS65XX. The remaining bytes (0x30 0x20) are passed to cs_disasm as the instruction stream. Byte 0x30 decodes as BMI (MOS65XX_INS_BMI) with MOS65XX_AM_REL addressing mode and 1 operand byte (0x20), successfully producing a disassembled instruction with detail populated.

Retrieves the instruction metadata for the decoded opcode (BMI, index MOS65XX_INS_BMI). The insinfo.group_type field is MOS65XX_GRP_JUMP, which is non-INVALID and will trigger the first group assignment. Combined with the MOS65XX_AM_REL addressing mode, both group-writing branches will execute.

The second group assignment writes MOS65XX_GRP_BRANCH_RELATIVE to the hardcoded index 0 instead of detail->groups[detail->groups_count]. Since groups_count was already incremented to 1 by the first branch, groups_count becomes 2 after this block, but groups[1] is never written. The fix changes both assignments to use detail->groups[detail->groups_count] so each group is stored at its proper sequential index.

The uninitialized value from detail->groups[1] arrives as the id parameter. MSan detects use-of-uninitialized-value at this comparison, where the indeterminate heap content is used in a conditional branch. If the value passes the bounds check, it would also be used as an index into GroupNames at line 520.

Loads instruction metadata for the decoded BMI opcode. insinfo.group_type = MOS65XX_GRP_JUMP (non-INVALID), which will cause the first group-writing branch to execute.

First group assignment: writes MOS65XX_GRP_JUMP to groups[0] (hardcoded index). groups_count is incremented to 1 on line 69. The group value is correctly stored but at a fixed position rather than the current count.

Second group assignment: overwrites groups[0] with MOS65XX_GRP_BRANCH_RELATIVE (also at hardcoded index 0 instead of groups[detail->groups_count] which is 1). groups_count is incremented to 2 on line 74. After this, groups_count=2 but groups[1] was never written — it retains uninitialized heap content from the cs_mem_malloc allocation.

Iterates n from 0 to groups_count-1 (i.e., n=0 and n=1). On the second iteration (n=1), reads detail->groups[1] which was never written by fillDetails — the value is uninitialized heap content. Passes this indeterminate value as the group argument to cs_group_name.
Passes the uninitialized group value from detail->groups[1] to handle->group_name, which resolves to MOS65XX_group_name for the MOS65XX architecture.

The uninitialized value arrives as id. MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value at this conditional branch, where the indeterminate heap content is first used in a comparison. This is the crash site reported by the sanitizer.
